proposition: Apparent support volume must be reduced to independent causal ancestry or the appropriate clustered independent unit before it can increase confidence in a premise.
evidence_summary: The inference-audit framework explicitly warns that reports/rows/summaries can descend from one causal observation; evaluation and human-parent contracts likewise distinguish raw row count from independent support and parent-family independence.
why_not_already_v1: V1 captures selection bias, trace censoring and population conditioning, but does not isolate pseudoreplication/causal ancestry as a general evidence premise.
admission_gate: Admit if reverse-source audit finds no v1 parent that cleanly entails causal-ancestry accounting without broad reinterpretation.

proposition: Runtime level-blindness, sample independence, distributional independence, and clustered/parent independence answer different questions and are not substitutes for one another.
evidence_summary: Evaluation authority names the first three independently; family research identifies parent family rather than descendant row as the usual independent unit.
why_not_already_v1: V1 has premises about level blindness, benchmark representativeness, generator coverage and construction bias, but the independence dimensions remain distributed across them rather than represented as an explicit claim-semantics split.
admission_gate: Admit as a scope split only if mining or audit decisions would otherwise treat one independence axis as evidence for another.

proposition: Evidence status is path-dependent and consumable: once an evaluation block or population outcome influences descendant design, it becomes development evidence for those descendants even if it was originally untouched confirmation evidence.
evidence_summary: Evaluation and operating-model authorities explicitly treat confirmation blocks as spent for descendants after outcomes influence redesign.
why_not_already_v1: V1 models temporal conditioning and endogenous residuals, but not the fact that observing/using evidence changes that evidence's future epistemic role.
admission_gate: Admit if temporal-conditioning metadata cannot express this without adding an explicit evidence-consumption relation.

proposition: A correctly narrow primary result can become broader, stronger, or differently authoritative as it propagates through reports, capability memory, question state, future-work prose, and execution priority; downstream claims must preserve scope, conditioning, authority, and ancestry.
evidence_summary: The inference-audit framework makes belief propagation into action a first-principles audit target and names overbroad closure/summary propagation as a recurring failure mode.
why_not_already_v1: V1 protects closure scope and information authority, but does not isolate semantic claim drift across repository consumers as its own failure process.
admission_gate: Admit if source-to-consumer claim traces demonstrate at least one materially decision-bearing scope/authority drift not captured by relation metadata alone.

proposition: An observation supports a causal research conclusion only to the extent that the observation could have discriminated that conclusion from materially different rival explanations.
evidence_summary: The inference-audit framework treats rival explanations and discriminability as a universal test, including capability absent vs unoffered/starved, premise false vs implementation form bad, and structural phenotype vs selection artifact.
why_not_already_v1: V1 contains many specific rival distinctions and counterfactual first-loss causality, but no general parent premise governing discriminability of research evidence.
admission_gate: Admit if the parent remains useful after checking whether v1 relation types plus P198 already express the same rule.

proposition: Premise-map completeness confidence requires reciprocal source coverage and independent-pass saturation evidence; proposition provenance and internal graph coverage are necessary but cannot establish that premise-bearing source regions were sampled.
evidence_summary: The pre-mining reverse-source audit exposes the asymmetry between every proposition having lineage and every premise-bearing source having a disposition.
why_not_already_v1: P196 recognizes ontology-edge blindness, but not reciprocal archaeology coverage or discovery-yield saturation as a completeness criterion.
admission_gate: Admit only into a post-v1 map version; keep outside the frozen v1 mining round to avoid circular mutation.

proposition: Heuristic invariance under an isomorphic puzzle transformation does not imply finite-budget search equivariance: successor order, secondary ties, retention, deduplication, truncation, and semantic random coupling can still produce systematically different reachable futures.
evidence_summary: Variant-family research distinguishes invariant scores from equivariant search traces and shows that the same raw PRNG seed is not semantic coupling when transformed executions consume randomness at different decisions.
why_not_already_v1: P015 asks about sound symmetry/canonicalization and P144 about perturbation fragility, but neither isolates transformation-equivariance of the full finite-budget search process.
admission_gate: Admit only if first-divergence evidence shows a recurring harmful arbitrary transformation bias that cannot be represented as an ordinary ordering/retention premise.
